questions: For decode_cyclic, should the implementation exactly match the reference solution (double encode) or should it invert the cyclic shift (e.g., group[-1] + group[:-1])?

Should groups be formed from the start of the string, or could they be formed from the end (e.g., last incomplete group first)?
If the input string contains newline characters or other non-printable characters, should they be treated as any other character?
Is the encoding intended to be applied only once per group, or could it be applied repeatedly (e.g., until a condition is met)?
For decode_cyclic, what should happen if the input string length is not a multiple of 3? Should it still decode correctly?
Should the functions preserve the exact input string identity (e.g., return the same object if no change) or is that not required?
Is the encoding defined only for ASCII strings, or for any Unicode string (including multi-code-unit characters)?
